beats.desc: the right hand holds the black exterior lock cylinder by its round rose and aligns its brass tailpiece with the bare-wood cross-bore hole in the door face while the left fingers steady the door
the right hand pushes the black lock cylinder toward the door so the brass tailpiece slides through the cross-bore into the latch and the black rose comes flush against the door face
beats.constraint: the hands stay on the black cylinder and the door face; the black latch faceplate and its silver bolt stay seated in the door edge.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt installs an exterior door-lock cylinder, threading its brass tailpiece through the door into the latch, working with both hands; the man
scene_keep: the white door, the black latch faceplate with its silver spring bolt on the door edge, the bare-wood cross-bore hole through the door face, the black lock cylinder with its brass tailpiece, and the bright sunny white porch with a railing behind
